name: telecom-district
description: Read-only access to your Telecom District Kontrol Edge services: ports, cloud connections, internet, DC interconnect, backbone, firewall and SD-WAN, alarms and maintenance.

interface.longDescription:
Telecom District's Kontrol Edge connects your cloud, data centers and sites. With this app, ChatGPT reads your Kontrol Edge services the same way the Telecom District console shows them: ports, cloud connections, internet, DC interconnect, backbone, firewall and SD-WAN services, with traffic and errors; alarms, incidents, outages and planned maintenance.

You sign in with your Telecom District account, including multi-factor authentication and your company's single sign-on. ChatGPT sees only what your account sees: a customer sees its own services, a partner sees its customers. Every tool is read-only: ChatGPT can answer and explain, never change anything.

Ask things like "Which of my cloud connections are down?", "Show my backbone services and their BGP sessions" or "Was there an incident on my services this week?".
defaultPrompt: Use Telecom District to tell me which of my cloud connections are down.
Use Telecom District to show my backbone services and their BGP sessions.
Use Telecom District to show the incidents on my services this week.

positive.description: Find the cloud connections that are down.
positive.prompt: Which of my Kontrol Edge cloud connections are down right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's cloud connections and names the ones whose status is down, with their provider and port. Says so plainly if none is down.

positive.description: Backbone services and their BGP sessions.
positive.prompt: Show my Kontrol Edge backbone services and their BGP sessions.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the backbone services and, for each, its BGP sessions with neighbor address and state.

positive.description: Recent incidents on the account's services.
positive.prompt: Were there any incidents on my Kontrol Edge services in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the incidents in the window with service, start and end time, and status; says there were none if the list is empty.

positive.prompt: Is any maintenance planned on my Kontrol Edge services?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming maintenance windows with the affected services and times in UTC.

positive.prompt: How much traffic did my busiest Kontrol Edge port carry in the last 24 hours?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the ports, reads traffic for the last 24 hours, and reports the busiest port's inbound and outbound peaks and averages.

negative.description: A change request: every tool is read-only.
negative.prompt: Delete my Kontrol Edge cloud connection to AWS.

negative.description: A question unrelated to the user's network.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Mexico City today?

negative.description: Another company's data, which the account cannot see.
negative.prompt: Show me the Kontrol Edge services of a company I don't belong to, Acme Corp.
